title: A real eye-opener!
text: A completely personalized visit to a little-known small country with an experienced guide over-the-top with information. Could not have asked for a better day!

title: Wonderful day
text: Miguel was an amazing guide. Very knowledgeable and passionate about describing his country and history. It was a beautiful day.
author: Andi_S

title: DAY TOUR TO ANDORRA (PYRENEES MTNS) RIVERS, VALLEYS VERY SCENIC
text: We were picked up from Espana Hotel, Barcelona 7am by our Guide/Driver "Feliciano Dominguez" who drove us to Andorra this is a considerable distance. On the way Feliciano pointed out important things, scenery and the fact that "Andorra" is a independent State between "Catalonia (Spain) and France. The Mountain scenery and rivers and farming area made for some excellent "Photo Stops" along the way.
